thag5.2:1.1: Ayoge yuñjam attānaṃ puriso kiccam icchato caraṃ ce nādhigaccheyya, taṃ me dubbhagalakkhaṇaṃ. || ||
thag5.2:2.1: abbūḷhaṃ aghataṃ vijitaṃ ekañ ce ossajjeyya kalī va siyā; sabbāni pi ce ossajjeyya andho va siyā samavisamassa adassanato.
thag5.2:4.1: yathāpi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ agandhakaṃ, evaṃ subhāsitā vācā aphalā hoti akubbato. || ||
thag5.2:5.1: yathāpi ruciraṃ pupphaṃ vaṇṇavantaṃ sagandhakaṃ evaṃ subhāsitā vācā saphalā hoti sakubbato 'ti. || || Subhūto thero.
